# Shop Packs
> Done-for-you template packs for service shops. Welding first.

## Topic map
- [Shop Packs topic map](https://shoppacks.net/topics.html): Done-for-you template packs for service shops. Welding first.
- **First reply:** [Free first-reply kit](https://shoppacks.net/magnet.html)
- **The pack:** [Welding Shop Operating Pack](https://shoppacks.net/)
- **Settings (sister):** [Welding calculator](https://welding-calculator.com/), [Settings card](https://welding-calculator.com/magnet.html)

## Templates
- [Welding shop quote template](https://shoppacks.net/welding-shop-quote-template.html): The 3 quote forms in the Welding Shop Operating Pack: small job, structural in 33% milestones, and emergency after-hours with $150 call-out language.
- [Welding shop follow-up text templates](https://shoppacks.net/welding-shop-follow-up-text-templates.html): The Welding Shop Operating Pack has 5 follow-up texts. See two sample texts, a post-quote nudge and a job-done review ask, with fill-in brackets. $49 once.

## Pricing
- The Pack: $49 once. Pack + We Host: $99. First-reply kit: free.
